invariant: Classification is diagnostic only. It never grants execution, source-write, retry, merge, deployment, secret, or lease authority.

SECURITY.action: Hold source-changing automation; preserve evidence and require security owner review.

retry.condition: Never retry or bypass a failed security gate.

ACCESS_CONFIG.action: Create a concrete owner action for the missing credential, permission, or environment setting; do not repeat unchanged workflow attempts.

retry.condition: Retry only after a verified configuration/permission change.

MERGE_CONFLICT.action: Route to semantic conflict resolution with exact base/head/diff; never apply blanket ours/theirs.

retry.condition: No retry until a validated conflict-resolution patch is available.

BASE_ADVANCED.action: Refresh live base/head and select protected rebase or synchronization path; preserve exact-head evidence.

retry.condition: Only after an explicit fresh-base check and single-writer lease.

BASE_OR_CI_ROUTING.action: Diagnose workflow ownership, exact-head routing, and missing required checks; do not authorize a source edit.

retry.condition: Only after the routing inputs or target state changed.

INFRASTRUCTURE.action: Separate transient runner/service failure from persistent infrastructure configuration; retry only transient failures with bounded backoff.

retry.condition: Transient timeout/startup/5xx only; same exact HEAD; no quota or permission retry; stop if the next attempt is identical.

AUTOMATION_PROCESS.action: Recover the existing task by idempotency key; inspect prompt receipt, assignment, lease, context, worker receipt, and finalizer before dispatching once.

retry.condition: Only after proving no active owner and no prior successful side effect.

AI_EXECUTOR.action: Preserve prompt/model/response metadata with redaction; validate free-model price and identity, then use one eligible zero-cost alternate or a deterministic tool.

retry.condition: No retry on quota/provider rejection; each alternate must be independently verified $0; reject invalid patches.

INTEGRATION.action: Route to the owner of the named API/provider; capture request correlation and redacted response metadata; keep access failures in ACCESS_CONFIG.

retry.condition: Only idempotent reads or after provider/config state changes; never replay non-idempotent writes.

TYPESCRIPT.action: Create a bounded source-repair task from exact failed step, changed paths, PR and HEAD; independent verification is mandatory.

retry.condition: One active worker per PR+HEAD; change strategy after a failed candidate; never rerun CI without a new verified source SHA.

TEST_FAILURE.action: Determine whether product code, fixture, environment, or the test oracle is wrong; retain regression coverage and never edit tests merely to obtain green CI.

retry.condition: Only after a concrete diagnosis or an independently justified transient/flaky-test reproduction.

SOURCE_CODE.action: Use deterministic formatting/lint tools where safe; otherwise send exact changed files and failure evidence to a zero-cost code executor.

retry.condition: One active worker per PR+HEAD; independent patch verification; no blind repeat.

UNKNOWN.action: Retain evidence and send to bounded secondary diagnostics; if confidence stays low, require a named human owner and next action.

retry.condition: No automatic execution until cause and action are established.
